steps.title: For a regular hexagon,
steps.body:
For a regular hexagon,

\[
\overrightarrow{OC}=\mathbf b-\mathbf a,\quad
\overrightarrow{OD}=-\mathbf a,\quad
\overrightarrow{OE}=-\mathbf b,\quad
\overrightarrow{OF}=\mathbf a-\mathbf b
\]

steps.title: The outer hexagon has scale
steps.body:
The outer hexagon has scale factor \(2\), so

\[
\overrightarrow{OI}=2(\mathbf b-\mathbf a),\quad
\overrightarrow{OK}=-2\mathbf b,\quad
\overrightarrow{OL}=2(\mathbf a-\mathbf b)
\]

steps.title: (b) The inner hexagon is
steps.body:
(b) The inner hexagon is made from 6 equal triangles like \(OAB\):

\[
\text{inner area}=6\times 5=30
\]

steps.title: The outer hexagon is an
steps.body:
The outer hexagon is an enlargement with scale factor \(2\), so area scale factor is \(2^2=4\):

\[
\text{outer area}=4\times 30=120
\]

\[
\text{shaded area}=120-30=90
\]

steps.title: For each chess game
steps.body:
For each chess game:

\[
P(M\text{ wins})=\frac29,\quad P(\text{draw})=\frac49,\quad P(M\text{ loses})=\frac13
\]

steps.title: After two games, equal points
steps.body:
After two games, equal points happens if both games are drawn or Magnus wins one and loses one.

\[
\left(\frac49\right)^2+2\left(\frac29\right)\left(\frac13\right)
\]

\[
=\frac{16}{81}+\frac{12}{81}=\frac{28}{81}
\]

steps.title: After three games, equal points
steps.body: After three games, equal points means Magnus scores \(3\) points in total.

steps.title: This happens with three draws,
steps.body:
This happens with three draws, or with one win, one draw and one loss.

\[
\left(\frac49\right)^3+6\left(\frac29\right)\left(\frac49\right)\left(\frac13\right)
\]

\[
=\frac{64}{729}+\frac{144}{729}=\frac{208}{729}
\]
